items.source: servletContext - current servlet context
items.translation: <servletContext> - 当前 Servlet 上下文

items.source: Return the ApplicationContextInitializer implementation classes to use if any have been specified by CONTEXT_INITIALIZER_CLASSES_PARAM.
items.translation: 返回 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 实现类，如果已指定了由 CONTEXT_INITIALIZER_CLASSES_PARAM 指定的任何此类。

items.source: Initialize Spring's web application context for the given servlet context, using the application context provided at construction time, or creating a new one according to the "contextClass" and "contextConfigLocation" context-params.
items.translation: 为给定的 Servlet 上下文初始化 Spring Web 应用程序上下文，使用构建时提供的应用程序上下文，或根据"contextClass"和"contextConfigLocation"上下文参数创建一个新的。

items.source: Specify which ApplicationContextInitializer instances should be used to initialize the application context used by this ContextLoader.
items.translation: 指定应使用哪些ApplicationContextInitializer实例来初始化此ContextLoader使用的应用程序上下文。

items.source: Config param for ApplicationContextInitializer classes to use for initializing the root web application context: "contextInitializerClasses".
items.translation: 用于初始化根 Web 应用上下文的 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 类的配置参数："contextInitializerClasses"。

items.source: Config param for global ApplicationContextInitializer classes to use for initializing all web application contexts in the current application: "globalInitializerClasses".
items.translation: 配置参数，用于指定全局 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 类，以初始化当前应用程序中的所有 Web 应用程序上下文："globalInitializerClasses"。

items.source: Looks for a "contextClass" parameter at the web.xml context-param level to specify the context class type, falling back to XmlWebApplicationContext if not found. With the default ContextLoader implementation, any context class specified needs to implement the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext interface.
items.translation: 查找 `` 的 `context-param` 级别的 `"contextClass"` 参数以指定上下文类类型，如果未找到则回退到 XmlWebApplicationContext。使用默认的 ContextLoader 实现时，指定的任何上下文类都需要实现 ConfigurableWebApplicationContext 接口。

items.source: ContextLoader supports injecting the root web application context via the ContextLoader(WebApplicationContext) constructor, allowing for programmatic configuration in Servlet initializers. See WebApplicationInitializer for usage examples.
items.translation: ContextLoader 支持通过 ContextLoader(WebApplicationContext) 构造函数注入根 Web 应用程序上下文，从而允许在 Servlet 初始化器中进行程序化配置。有关使用示例，请参阅 WebApplicationInitializer。

items.source: Any ApplicationContextInitializers implementing Ordered or marked with @Order will be sorted appropriately.
items.translation: 任何实现Ordered的ApplicationContextInitializers或标记有@Order的初始化器都将按适当顺序排序。

items.source: The created application context will be registered into the ServletContext under the attribute name WebApplicationContext.ROOT_WEB_APPLICATION_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE and subclasses are free to call the closeWebApplicationContext(ServletContext) method on container shutdown to close the application context.
items.translation: 创建的应用上下文将注册到 ServletContext 的属性名称 WebApplicationContext.ROOT_WEB_APPLICATION_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE 下，子类可以在容器关闭时调用 closeWebApplicationContext(ServletContext) 方法来关闭应用上下文。

items.source: The context may or may not yet be refreshed. If it (a) is an implementation of ConfigurableWebApplicationContext and (b) has not already been refreshed (the recommended approach), then the following will occur:
items.translation: 上下文可能尚未刷新。如果它 (a) 是ConfigurableWebApplicationContext的实现，并且 (b) 尚未被刷新（推荐的方法），则会发生以下情况：

items.source: In any case, the given application context will be registered into the ServletContext under the attribute name WebApplicationContext.ROOT_WEB_APPLICATION_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE and subclasses are free to call the closeWebApplicationContext(ServletContext) method on container shutdown to close the application context.
items.translation: 无论如何，给定的应用程序上下文将注册到 `ServletContext` 中，属性名称为 WebApplicationContext.ROOT_WEB_APPLICATION_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE，子类可以在容器关闭时自由调用 closeWebApplicationContext(ServletContext) 方法来关闭应用程序上下文。

items.source: This constructor is typically used when declaring the ContextLoaderListener subclass as a <listener> within web.xml, as a no-arg constructor is required.
items.translation: 此构造函数通常用于在 `web.xml` 中将 `` 声明为 `ContextLoaderListener` 的子类，因为需要一个无参构造函数。

items.source: The default implementation determines what (if any) context initializer classes have been specified through context init parameters and invokes each with the given web application context.
items.translation: 默认实现 确定 是否通过 上下文初始化参数 指定了任何上下文初始化类，并 调用每个 类，传入给定的 Web 应用程序上下文。

items.source: Processes a "contextConfigLocation" context-param and passes its value to the context instance, parsing it into potentially multiple file paths which can be separated by any number of commas and spaces, for example, "WEB-INF/applicationContext1.xml, WEB-INF/applicationContext2.xml". Ant-style path patterns are supported as well, for example, "WEB-INF/*Context.xml,WEB-INF/spring*.xml" or "WEB-INF/**/*Context.xml". If not explicitly specified, the context implementation is supposed to use a default location (with XmlWebApplicationContext: "/WEB-INF/applicationContext.xml").
items.translation: 处理 `"contextConfigLocation"` 上下文参数，并将其值传递给上下文实例。该值会被解析为多个潜在的文件路径，这些路径可由任意数量的逗号和空格分隔，例如，"WEB-INF/applicationContext1.xml, WEB-INF/applicationContext2.xml"。同时也支持 Ant 风格的路径模式，例如，"WEB-INF/*Context.xml,WEB-INF/spring*.xml" 或 "WEB-INF/**/*Context.xml"。如果未显式指定，则上下文实现应使用默认位置（对于 XmlWebApplicationContext："/WEB-INF/applicationContext.xml"）。

items.source: Above and beyond loading the root application context, this class can optionally load or obtain and hook up a shared parent context to the root application context. See the loadParentContext(ServletContext) method for more information.
items.translation: 除了加载根应用程序上下文之外，该类还可以选择性地加载或获取并连接到根应用程序上下文的共享父上下文。有关更多信息，请参阅loadParentContext(ServletContext)方法。

items.source: See WebApplicationInitializer for usage examples.
items.translation: 参见WebApplicationInitializer中的使用示例。

items.source: This implementation expects custom contexts to implement the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext interface. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 此实现期望自定义上下文实现 ConfigurableWebApplicationContext 接口。可在子类中重写。

items.source: In addition, customizeContext(ServletContext, ConfigurableWebApplicationContext) gets called prior to refreshing the context, allowing subclasses to perform custom modifications to the context.
items.translation: 此外，在刷新上下文之前会调用customizeContext(ServletContext, ConfigurableWebApplicationContext)，从而允许子类对上下文执行自定义修改。

items.source: If overriding loadParentContext(ServletContext), you may have to override this method as well.
items.translation: 如果重写了loadParentContext(ServletContext)，您可能也需要重写此方法。

items.source: The default implementation simply returns null, as of 5.0.
items.translation: 默认实现自 5.0 版本起仅返回null。

items.source:
Note: In case of multiple config locations, later bean definitions will
override ones defined in previously loaded files, at least when using one of
Spring's default ApplicationContext implementations. This can be leveraged
to deliberately override certain bean definitions via an extra XML file.
items.translation: 注意：在存在多个配置位置的情况下，后续定义的 Bean 将覆盖先前加载文件中定义的 Bean（至少在使用 Spring 的默认 ApplicationContext 实现时是这样）。可以利用这一点，通过额外的 XML 文件有目的地覆盖某些 Bean 定义。

items.source:
The main reason to load a parent context here is to allow multiple root
web application contexts to all be children of a shared EAR context, or
alternately to also share the same parent context that is visible to
EJBs. For pure web applications, there is usually no need to worry about
having a parent context to the root web application context.
items.translation: 在此处加载父上下文的主要原因是，允许多个根 Web 应用程序上下文都成为共享 EAR 上下文的子上下文，或者替代地，也共享同一个对 EJB 可见的父上下文。对于纯 Web 应用程序，通常无需担心为根 Web 应用程序上下文设置一个父上下文。

items.source: Customize the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext created by this ContextLoader after config locations have been supplied to the context but before the context is refreshed.
items.translation: 在将配置位置提供给上下文但在上下文被刷新之前，自定义由该 ContextLoader 创建的ConfigurableWebApplicationContext。

items.source:

items.translation: 指定根上下文配置位置的 Servlet 上下文参数名称（即"contextConfigLocation"），否则将回退到实现类的默认值。

items.source: Config param for the root WebApplicationContext implementation class to use: "contextClass".
items.translation: 用于配置根 WebApplicationContext 实现类的参数："contextClass"。
